name: lf11_11_disconnected
description: Conformance test 11. A zone that is not connected takes nothing (no put_in, supply unchanged) but still decays (10000 -> 9300); a zot 0x107A0000 goes to the first mask cell spiralling from the centre, here the centre (11, 21) itself, at (16x + 8, terrain + 3.0, 16z + 8); the zone counts for nothing in capacityTotal, usedTotal and SetGarbageCapacity. A second disconnected month keeps the one zot. Once connected, the next month removes the zot and the zone counts again (4 heaps x 67500). Then the two worked examples of 4.7.5 (LF4: ring r starts at (cx + r, cz - r + 1) and runs +z, -x, -z, +x): the same 3 x 3 zone disconnected with its centre (11, 21) dezoned puts its zot on (12, 21), the first ring-1 cell (a top-left-corner order would give (10, 20)); a fresh developer with a zone over x 10..14, z 20..22 where only (10, 20) and (14, 22) are set puts its zot on (14, 22), because ring 2 clipped to the rect runs (14, 20), (14, 21), (14, 22), (10, 22), (10, 21), (10, 20).
